theory.name: SaaSy Reduced Hamiltonian Program
theory.summary: A documentary and formal package shell for the reduced Hamiltonian closure research program.
theory.motivation: Bring an active theory into Parallax before pretending every derivation has already become executable software.

objects.name: Parent system
objects.definition: The unreduced mathematical system from which a bounded reduced description is derived.

objects.name: Reduced system
objects.definition: The retained variables, operators, and terms after a declared reduction.

objects.name: Derivation step
objects.definition: A typed transformation or identity in the derivation tower with explicit dependencies.

objects.name: Bounded claim
objects.definition: A proposition tagged by scope, evidence, dependencies, and promotion status.

operators.name: reduction map
operators.semantics: CANDIDATE — specify the exact admissible reduction and retained or discarded information.

operators.name: derivation step
operators.semantics: CANDIDATE — apply one lawful symbolic derivation rule with explicit assumptions and dependencies.

operators.name: claim promotion
operators.semantics: Move a claim to a stronger review state only when its declared proof obligations are satisfied.

assumptions.text: Every retained and discarded term must be explicitly classified.
A reduced closure claim remains bounded to its declared dimensional and source assumptions.

invariants.text: No derivation step may lose its declared dependency set.
A promoted claim must remain attached to the derivation and assumptions that earned promotion.

allowed: the package documents objects, assumptions, derivation dependencies, and proof obligations
a statement is identified as candidate, derived, or unresolved
prohibited: the theory is executable in the current finite-vector kernel
formal coherence alone establishes physical truth

evidence.notes: Empirical and literature comparison requirements remain to be registered as a separate evidence lane.
